key_vocab.definition: An algebraic fraction has expressions with letters in the numerator, denominator, or both (e.g. &frac{x+2}{3} or &frac{2x}{x−1}).

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can simplify, add, subtract, multiply and divide algebraic fractions.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: algebraic fraction -- An algebraic fraction has expressions with letters in the numerator, denominator, or both (e.g. &frac{x+2}{3} or &frac{2x}{x−1}).

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Treat algebraic fractions like number fractions. Factorise first, then cancel common factors.
&frac{2x + 4}{2} = &frac{2(x + 2)}{2} = x + 2
Factorise numerator, then cancel

Key examples:
  ✓ &frac{6x}{3} = 2x  (simplify by cancelling)
  ✓ &frac{x}{3} + &frac{x}{4} = &frac{7x}{12}  (common denominator 12)
  ✓ &frac{x+2}{x+2} = 1  (cancel identical factors)
  ✗ &frac{x+2}{x} = 2  (cannot cancel part of a sum)
  ✗ &frac{x}{3} + &frac{x}{4} = &frac{2x}{7}  (cannot add denominators)
